name: fczero
text:
`repro` results go straight into README claims. Make `repro` trustworthy enough for that. One known gap: `--plans` can point `repro` at plans with a scoring seed (1-1200), and `repro` must apply the same freeze check as `run` to every plan before running it (exit 5).

The hidden tests rely on this interface: `reproduce` and `reproduceAll` take an optional last argument, the schedule runner (default `runSchedule`), so tests can replace Docker.
